      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "RPCs that merely report peer state and the bookkeeping that feeds them are explicitly excluded from P2P."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/net.cpp and src/bitcoin-cli.cpp to expose cpu_load in getpeerinfo and -netinfo.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR adds a new `cpu_load` metric to `getpeerinfo` and `bitcoin-cli -netinfo` to allow node operators to monitor peer CPU consumption. The author notes that \"monitoring CPU usage is useful on its own\" and reviewers agree it is \"useful for detecting attackers in an actual DoS attack\" (mzumsande) and as a \"first step for anti-DoS measures\" (laanwj), though it represents an unrequested diagnostic field that is reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds thread CPU timing primitives in src/util/time.h and src/util/time.cpp (+100 lines).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR introduces reusable cross-platform per-thread CPU timing utilities in `src/util/time.{h,cpp}` using `clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID)` on POSIX and `GetThreadTimes()` on Windows. While providing a well-defined utility for timing thread execution, it is an incremental addition to support diagnostic reporting and is deferrable."
    }
